name: energyflow
title: EnergyFlow
shortDesc: AI-powered analytics platform for energy companies. Multiview clustering, load forecasting, and anomaly detection on smart meter data.

details.overview: EnergyFlow is a full-stack smart meter analytics platform that helps energy companies understand consumption patterns across thousands of meters. It combines multiview clustering (FastMICE algorithm), gradient-boosted load forecasting, and LSTM-based anomaly detection into a single interactive dashboard. The backend processes multiview datasets (consumption, temperature, solar radiation) through ML pipelines, while the Angular frontend renders real-time KPIs, interactive ECharts visualizations, and geographic cluster maps — all in a dark-themed, responsive interface.

features.title: Multiview Customer Segmentation
features.desc: Groups smart meters into clusters using the FastMICE ensemble consensus algorithm across three data views — consumption profiles, temperature, and solar radiation — producing 336-dimensional centroid load profiles. FastMICE is over 900x faster than neural network-based multiview clustering solutions while achieving superior accuracy. For more details, please refer to my master's thesis.

features.title: Load Forecasting
features.desc: Predicts next 7–24 day consumption per cluster using Gradient Boosting Regressors with engineered features, expanding-window cross-validation, and 95% confidence intervals.

features.title: Anomaly & Fraud Detection
features.desc: Trains per-cluster LSTM models combined with Robust EHWS smoothing to flag meters with abnormal consumption, ranking them by severity (critical, high, medium, fraud suspect).

features.title: Interactive Analytics Dashboard
features.desc: Cluster KPI cards, 365-day centroid line charts, temperature correlation scatter plots, variability bar charts, and zone-based geographic distribution donuts — all powered by Apache ECharts.

features.title: Meter-Level Drill-Down
features.desc: Click any meter in the anomaly table to view its individual consumption vs. centroid vs. LSTM prediction timeline with highlighted anomaly flags.

features.title: Model Evaluation Suite
features.desc: Cross-validation fold tables, feature importance rankings, and aggregate MAE/RMSE/MAPE metrics for transparent model performance assessment.
